errors.not_found: Not found – or you have no access.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.invalid_credentials: User name or password is wrong.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.password_change_required: Please change your start password first.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own admin rights or deactivate yourself.
errors.permission_not_for_side: This permission does not fit the side (Slimstock/customer).
errors.role_not_for_side: This role does not fit the person (Slimstock/customer).
errors.unknown_user: This person does not exist (any more).
errors.already_member: This person is already on the project.

errors.version_locked: This version can no longer be changed.
errors.dependency_cycle: This link would create a circle.

errors.unknown_item: This task does not exist (any more).
errors.unknown_subproject: This subproject does not exist (any more).
errors.assignee_not_member: Only people on the project can be assigned.
errors.status_not_allowed: Not possible in the version's current state.
errors.link_only_for_customers: Links are for customer people only – Slimstock logs in with user name and password.
errors.reason_required: Please give a reason when rejecting.

login.intro: Log in with your Slimstock account.
login.customerHint: As a customer you don't need a password – you get a personal link to your project.
login.linkInvalid: This link is not valid (any more). Please ask your project for a new one.

password.title: Change password
password.rule: At least {{min}} characters. A sentence of several words is easy to remember and secure.
password.firstIntro: You logged in with a start password. Please set your own password now.
password.changed: Password changed. You have to log in again on other devices.

projects.title: Projects
projects.search: Search by project, code or customer …
projects.empty: You are not on any project yet. As soon as someone adds you, it shows up here.
projects.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create the first one with “New project”.

project.name: Name
project.languageHint: Default language for everyone on this project; everybody can switch for themselves.
project.planEmpty: No tasks in the plan yet.

members.addRolesIntro: This person is on a parent project. Here you can give them extra roles for “{{project}}” only.
members.name: Name
members.emailHint: The e-mail address lets the app recognise the same person across projects.
members.permissionHint: Usually it follows from the roles. Only adjust if needed.

roles.intro: Project roles describe what someone does on a project. They set the default permission and will be the columns of the effort estimation.
roles.defaultPermissionHint: Applies to everyone with this role unless the project says otherwise.
roles.calculatedLabel: Estimated (own column in the effort estimation)

admin.usersIntro: Slimstock staff with user name and password. Customers don't need an account.
admin.resetIntro: Set a start password and hand it over safely. It has to be changed at the next login; existing sessions end.
admin.resetDone: Done. A new own password has to be chosen at the next login.
admin.usernameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash – e.g. anna.berger
admin.startPasswordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Must be changed at the first login.
admin.isAdminLabel: Admin (manage users, roles, customers and all projects)
admin.noCustomers: No customers yet. They are also created together with a project.

plan.internalLabel: Internal – the customer does not see this task
plan.empty: No tasks yet. Add the first one above.

conflict.start: The fixed start lies before the predecessors end.
conflict.end: The fixed end does not fit the predecessors.
conflict.deadline: The planned end lies after the deadline.
conflict.resource: Someone is booked twice at the same time.

plan.subprojectRow: Subproject – period and progress follow from its tasks.
plan.phaseHint: Phase – period and progress follow from the tasks inside. Links of a phase apply to all its tasks.
plan.calcHint: Grey = calculated. What you enter is a constraint; ↺ calculates again.
plan.lagHint: Lag in working days, negative = overlap
plan.addHint: New tasks go after the selected row – at the end of a selected phase or subproject. ⇥ makes a task part of the row above (that is how phases are made).
plan.legend: Red = critical path, dashed = deadline. Click shows the details.
plan.legendEdit: Drag a bar to move its start, its right edge to change the duration. Red = critical path, dashed = deadline.
plan.levelHint: Everyone does their tasks one after the other; where they overlap, the one with the least float goes first.

versions.metaInitial: Valid plan – this is where the ongoing work happens
versions.toReviewHint: Locks the draft so nobody agrees to a moving target
versions.confirmDiscard: Discard this draft? It stays in the list and can be brought back.
versions.newDraftIntro: The draft is a copy you can plan in freely – the working version stays untouched until you accept it.
versions.name: Name
versions.descriptionHint: Helps when reviewing and in the history.
versions.acceptIntro: The draft becomes the new working version. The current working version stays read-only in the history.
versions.acceptChanges: What changes compared to the working version
versions.carriedTitle: Taken over from the working version (actual data)
versions.carriedNone: Nothing – progress and actual dates are the same.
versions.lostTitle: Changes in the working version that are not taken over
versions.lostIntro: These planning changes were made in the working version after the draft was created. They are missing in the draft and will only remain in the history.
versions.lockedReview: This draft is in review and locked. Take it back to change it.
versions.lockedOld: This version is view only. Create a new draft from it to make changes.

effort.noRoles: There are no estimated project roles – an admin sets them under Administration → Project roles.
effort.pending: Budget is set when the draft is accepted
effort.fixedHint: With a fixed price the budget stays fixed; extra effort is Slimstock's risk.
effort.planHint: Days per role, in quarter days.
effort.orphan: Plus {{days}} actual days on tasks that do not exist in this version.
effort.readOnlyBookings: Bookings apply to all versions of the plan.
effort.fixedNew: {{unit}}: new fixed price – the budget is set to {{plan}} days.
effort.asChangeRequest: Change request – raise the budget to the plan
effort.withinFixed: Within the fixed price – budget stays
effort.durationFromEffortHint: Without a given duration a task takes as long as the role with the most effort – divided by the people with that role on the task.
effort.effortViewLabel: What the customer sees of the estimate

effortView.customer: Only the days of their own people
effortView.full: All days with actual and forecast

links.title: Personal link for {{name}}
links.intro: With this link the person gets straight into this project without a password. It does not expire – best saved as a bookmark.
links.mailBody:
Hello {{name}},

here is your personal access to the project “{{project}}”:
{{url}}

You don't need a password. Best save the link as a bookmark and don't pass it on – whoever has it sees the project.

Kind regards
links.warning: Whoever has the link is in. If it was passed on, renew it – the old one stops working at once.
links.confirmRenew: Create a new link for {{name}}? The current one stops working at once and open sessions end.

reviews.stale: before it was taken back – no longer valid
reviews.intro: This draft is waiting for your review. Look at the changes and approve – or reject with a reason.
reviews.noApproval: The customer has not approved this draft (yet). You can accept it anyway.
